promotion.contract: every blocker must clear before a row may be published as a usable fair-value range

structure.book_roll_forward: B_t = B_(t-1) * (1 + g); Yoo sets g = LTROE * (1 - dividend payout)
structure.terminal: RI_N / d(Rf), discounted N years; the omega = 1 case of Ohlson persistence
structure.evidence: reproduces the 54 published 2025-12-09 grid cells; see runStructuralReproduction

frozen.anchor: the index's own rolling 260-week median forward ROE
frozen.fit_observables: printed LTROE axis centres only: three from the 2025-12-09 index sheets and four from the 2026-08-03 Samsung and SK Hynix scenarios. No published upside is inverted into the fit, which leaves both two-sided claims free to evaluate it.
frozen.cross_family_bridge: the stock sheets contribute the large-gap regime only; their implied gap share of 0.622~0.756 brackets the share the index rows imply, which is the measured agreement that licenses the transfer
frozen.lattice_note: Yoo prints a +/-0.5pp LTROE axis; the same half width is retained

frozen.derivation: direct constituent payout over raw tracker ratio on the same basis at 2026-07-31: SPX 0.207125/0.201689 = 1.027 and NDX 0.097061/0.091662 = 1.059; the band spans the two and their midpoint is the centre
frozen.swept: the low and high multipliers are swept into the published endpoints so the measured divergence is visible rather than hidden
frozen.rejected: a universal scalar fitted to the printed/grid/LSEG payouts, which are trailing realised or inverted quantities and not the same variable as a tracker distribution yield

published_upside_holdout.note: floor anchors are one-sided and are passed by almost any positive band; only point-in-time two-sided rows outside the fit set discriminate, and later-vintage inputs are reported as not evaluable

operands.book: B0 = px_last / px_to_book_ratio from the benchmark panel; reproduces Yoo's printed feed book to 0.0004%~0.013%
operands.risk_free: sovereign 10Y for the index's own market; DGS10 read 4.18% on the day Yoo printed 4.2%
operands.erp: Yoo's printed three-point 0.5pp lattice for the asset class
operands.lt_roe: anchored on the index's own 260-week median, plus a concave function of how far its forward ROE runs above that median; swept +/-0.5pp on Yoo's printed axis width
operands.payout: Yoo's own cash dividend payout, read from the automatic trailing payout series so it refreshes instead of being hand-entered
operands.discount_horizon_terminal: d(Rf) = 0.076 + 0.560 * Rf, N = 9, terminal RI_N / d; reproduces the 54 published cells

book_growth.equation: g = LTROE * (1 - payout), which is Yoo's own roll-forward
book_growth.convexity_disclosure: the terminal capitalises year-9 residual income as a zero-growth perpetuity, so a row whose growth runs far above the discount rate is reported as convex or amplifying; the flag is disclosed, the published value is not altered
book_growth.sustainability: every operand moves with the panel, the rate series and the payout series; none is hand-entered

feno_rule.output: low/high only, swept over the LTROE and ERP lattices; never a point

interpretation: One rule. Every operand refreshes automatically from a panel that carries its own history, and every frozen constant carries a calibration receipt. The payout is Yoo's own cash dividend ratio, read from the automatic trailing series rather than hand-entered. A row whose book growth runs far above the discount rate is flagged convex or amplifying; the flag is disclosed and the value is left alone. No point estimate, no runtime Yoo value.
